description: Implement `transmit_token`: send the NUL-terminated JSON text in `token_json` as the body of an HTTP POST request to `endpoint` with header `Content-Type: application/json` using the Windows WinHTTP API (`WinHttpOpen`, `WinHttpConnect`, `WinHttpOpenRequest`, `WinHttpSendRequest`, `WinHttpReceiveResponse`, `WinHttpQueryHeaders`). Return 0 only when the HTTP status code is 200, otherwise -1.
name: transmit_token
